042/**
043 * The pets JSON endpoints (server-mode datatable query over BeanQuery, create/replace/delete, sell, stage, and the
044 * per-pet feeds), the Pets and Sold pages, the add/edit dialog form, and the P4 pet pages: Summary (inline edit),
045 * Photo, Orders (with a row detail, and one order selected at nav depth 4) and History, whose nav nodes the page
046 * appends under {@code pets} as {@code p<petId>} and {@code o<orderId>}.  The Pending changes page is the
047 * {@link ChangesRest} child.
048 *
049 * <h2 class='section'>Example:</h2>
050 * <p class='bjava'>
051 *    <jc>// The BQ#6 endpoint behind the table.</jc>
052 *    <ja>@RestPost</ja>(path=<js>"/query"</js>)
053 *    <jk>public</jk> DataTablesResults&lt;Pet&gt; query(<ja>@Content</ja> DataTablesRequest <jv>req</jv>) {
054 *       <jk>try</jk> (<jk>var</jk> <jv>s</jv> = store().queryPets()) {
055 *          <jk>return</jk> DataTablesQuery.<jsm>run</jsm>(<jv>req</jv>, <jv>s</jv>);
056 *       }
057 *    }
058 * </p>
059 * <p class='bcode'>
060 *    &lt;@card type="datatables" id="pets"&gt;
061 *    { dataMode:'server', dataUrl:'/console/pets/query', columns:[{key:'name', label:'Name'}, ...] }
062 *    &lt;/@card&gt;
063 * </p>
064 * <p class='bjava'>
065 *    <jc>// The same table in the builder twin.</jc>
066 *    TableSpec.<jsm>create</jsm>(<js>"pets"</js>).dataMode(DataMode.<jsf>SERVER</jsf>).dataUrl(<js>"/console/pets/query"</js>)
067 *       .columns(Column.<jsm>create</jsm>(<js>"name"</js>).label(<js>"Name"</js>));
068 * </p>
069 */
070@Rest(path="/pets", title="Pets", children={ChangesRest.class})
071@SuppressWarnings({
072   "java:S110" // Inheritance depth comes from the BasicRestServlet hierarchy, not this page.
073})

158   /**
159    * The add/edit dialog form.
160    *
161    * @param id The pet to edit, or <jk>null</jk> to add.
162    * @return The modal.
163    * @throws NotFound If {@code id} names no pet.
164    */
165   @RestGet(path="/form")
166   public ModalDef form(@Query("id") Long id) {
167      var p = id == null ? new Pet().setStatus(PetStatus.AVAILABLE) : require(id);
168      var form = FormDef.create()
169         .field(FormDef.Input.of("name", "Name", "text").required().value(p.getName()));
170      var species = FormDef.Input.of("species", "Species", "select").required();
171      for (var s : Species.values())
172         species.option(s.name(), s.name().charAt(0) + s.name().substring(1).toLowerCase());
173      if (p.getSpecies() != null)
174         species.value(p.getSpecies().name());
175      form.field(species);
176      form.field(FormDef.Input.of("price", "Price (USD)", "text").required().value(id == null ? "" : String.valueOf(p.getPrice())));
177      return ModalDef.create(id == null ? "Add pet" : f("Edit '%s'", p.getName())).form(form);
178   }

180   /**
181    * Server-mode DataTables query over all pets.
182    *
183    * <p>
184    * The optional {@code ids} query parameter (comma-separated pet ids, as the {@code ids} URL-state directive sends it)
185    * narrows the pets to those ids, before the request's own column filters apply, so the two combine.  Tokens that are
186    * not numbers are dropped, and a blank value or one with no usable token is ignored.
187    *
188    * @param req The DataTables request.
189    * @param ids The ids to keep, or {@code null}.
190    * @return One page of pets, or a 200 {@code error} envelope for a malformed search expression.
191    */
192   @RestPost(path="/query")
193   public DataTablesResults<Pet> query(@Content DataTablesRequest req, @Query("ids") @Schema(aev=true) String ids) {
194      var wanted = parseIds(ids);
195      var pets = store().getPets();
196      if (wanted != null)
197         pets = pets.stream().filter(p -> wanted.contains(p.getId())).toList();
198      try (var s = PetStore.PET_QUERY.getSession(pets)) {
199         return DataTablesQuery.run(req, s);
200      } catch (BeanQuerySyntaxException e) {
201         // DataTablesQuery maps a bad expression to HTTP 400 by default; the table wants a 200 error envelope it can show.
202         return DataTablesResults.error(req.getDraw(), e.getMessage());
203      }
204   }
205
206   /** The usable ids in a comma-separated value, or {@code null} if there are none (no filter). */
207   @SuppressWarnings({
208      "java:S1168" // null means no filter, distinct from an empty id set
209   })
210   private static Set<Long> parseIds(String value) {
211      if (value == null)
212         return null;
213      var out = new HashSet<Long>();
214      for (var token : value.split(",")) {
215         try {
216            out.add(Long.parseLong(token.trim()));
217         } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") NumberFormatException e) {
218            // Not a pet id; dropped.
219         }
220      }
221      return out.isEmpty() ? null : out;
222   }

224   /**
225    * Creates a pet.  Status defaults to {@code AVAILABLE}.
226    *
227    * @param req The request (write gate, audit actor).
228    * @param body The new pet, either as the plain pet or as the dialog envelope {@code {fields:{...}}}.
229    * @return The result toast, carrying the stored pet.
230    * @throws BadRequest On a blank name or negative price.
231    */
232   @RestPost(path="/")
233   public ActionResult create(RestRequest req, @Content JsonMap body) {
234      var actor = ConsoleWrites.actor(req);
235      var pet = toPet(body);
236      validate(pet);
237      if (pet.getStatus() == null)
238         pet.setStatus(PetStatus.AVAILABLE);
239      var p = store().createPet(pet, actor);
240      return ActionResult.success(p).message(f("Added '%s'", p.getName()));
241   }
242
243   /**
244    * Replaces a pet.  Name and price are required; a species, tags or photo left out of the body keep their
245    * current values, as does the status.
246    *
247    * @param req The request.
248    * @param id The pet id.
249    * @param body The new state, either as the plain pet or as the dialog envelope {@code {fields:{...}}}.
250    * @return The result toast.
251    * @throws NotFound If the pet does not exist.
252    */
253   @RestPut(path="/{id}")
254   public ActionResult update(RestRequest req, @Path("id") long id, @Content JsonMap body) {
255      // The edit form offers name, species and price but no status, so for a saved edit (for example from the
256      // store treemap) species is the grouping field that can change; status moves only through the sell action.
257      var actor = ConsoleWrites.actor(req);
258      var old = require(id);
259      var pet = toPet(body);
260      validate(pet);
261      pet.setId(id);
262      pet.defaultStatus(old.getStatus()).defaultSpecies(old.getSpecies()).defaultTags(old.getTags()).defaultPhoto(old.getPhoto());
263      return ActionResult.success(store().updatePet(pet, actor)).message(f("Saved '%s'", pet.getName()));
264   }

266   /**
267    * Deletes a pet.
268    *
269    * @param req The request.
270    * @param id The pet id.
271    * @return The result toast.
272    * @throws NotFound If the pet does not exist.
273    */
274   @RestDelete(path="/{id}")
275   public ActionResult delete(RestRequest req, @Path("id") long id) {
276      var actor = ConsoleWrites.actor(req);
277      var p = require(id);
278      store().deletePet(id, actor);
279      return ActionResult.success(null).message(f("Deleted '%s'", p.getName()));

282   /**
283    * Marks a pet sold.  The Pets page bulk "Mark sold (N)" action calls this per row.
284    *
285    * @param req The request.
286    * @param id The pet id.
287    * @return The result toast, carrying the updated pet.
288    * @throws NotFound If the pet does not exist.
289    * @throws Conflict If it is already sold.
290    */
291   @RestPost(path="/{id}/sell")
292   public ActionResult sell(RestRequest req, @Path("id") long id) {
293      var actor = ConsoleWrites.actor(req);
294      var p = require(id);
295      if (p.getStatus() == PetStatus.SOLD)
296         throw new Conflict("Pet '%s' is already '%s'", id, p.getStatus());
297      // Update a copy: the live pet must not change unless the store accepts the write.
298      var sold = new Pet().setId(p.getId()).setSpecies(p.getSpecies()).setName(p.getName()).setPrice(p.getPrice())
299         .setTags(p.getTags()).setStatus(PetStatus.SOLD).setPhoto(p.getPhoto());
300      return ActionResult.success(store().updatePet(sold, actor)).message(f("Sold '%s'", p.getName()));
301   }
302
303   /**
304    * Stages an inline edit for review on the Pending changes page.  The pet itself is not changed until the change is applied.
305    *
306    * <p>
307    * {@link PendingChanges#stage} owns which fields are stageable and its messages.  The photo is deliberately not
308    * stageable: the pet detail Photo tab edits it directly through the API's own {@code PUT /petstore/pets/{id}/photo}.
309    *
310    * @param req The request.
311    * @param id The pet id.
312    * @param body {@code {field, value}}, or the inline-edit envelope {@code {fields:{<field>:value}}} with exactly one field.
313    * @return {@code success} carrying the new {@link PendingChange}.
314    * @throws BadRequest If the field is missing or not stageable, or the value is invalid.
315    * @throws NotFound If the pet does not exist.
316    */
317   @RestPost(path="/{id}/stage")
318   public ActionResult stage(RestRequest req, @Path("id") long id, @Content JsonMap body) {
319      var actor = ConsoleWrites.actor(req);
320      String field;
321      String value;
322      // The 'edit' column renderer commits {fields:{<column>:value}} (plus its dialog envelope keys) through the row action.
323      var fields = body.getMap("fields");
324      if (fields != null) {
325         if (fields.size() != 1)
326            throw new BadRequest("Exactly one field can be staged at a time; got '%s'", fields.size());
327         field = fields.keySet().iterator().next();
328         value = fields.getString(field);
329      } else {
330         field = body.getString("field");
331         value = body.getString("value");
332      }
333      if (ib(field))
334         throw new BadRequest("Missing field to stage");
335      try {
336         var c = store().pendingChanges().stage(id, field, value, ConsoleWrites.author(actor));
337         return ActionResult.success(c).message(f("Staged '%s'", c.getSummary()));
338      } catch (PetstoreNotFoundException e) {
339         throw new NotFound(e.getMessage());
340      } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
341         throw new BadRequest(e.getMessage());
342      }
343   }

436   private View petPage(RestRequest req, RestResponse res, long id, String tab, Order order) {
437      var p = store().getPet(id);
438      if (p == null) {
439         // A View, not a thrown NotFound, so the not-found card renders inside the chrome.
440         res.setStatus(404);
441         return FreemarkerView.of("pet-not-found.ftlh").attr("message", f("Unknown pet '%s'", id));
442      }
443      // Node ids must start with a letter, so the pet node is p<id> and the order node o<id>.
444      var nav = order == null ? f("pets/p%s/%s", id, tab) : f("pets/p%s/orders/o%s", id, order.getId());
445      // The API's CSRF token, published by the console boundary on allowed requests; absent means the upload form renders without one.
446      var servletReq = req.getHttpServletRequest();
447      var apiCsrf = servletReq.getAttribute(PetstoreApiBoundary.TOKEN_ATTRIBUTE) instanceof String s ? s : null;
448      if (builder(req))
449         return twin(req, PetsPageBuilders.pet(p, tab, nav, order, ConsoleWrites.roles(req), apiCsrf));
450      var v = FreemarkerView.of("pet.ftlh").attr("pet", p).attr("tab", tab).attr("activeNav", nav)
451         .attr("pageTitle", p.getName()).attr("roles", ConsoleWrites.roles(req));
452      if (apiCsrf != null)
453         v = v.attr("apiCsrf", apiCsrf);
454      return order == null ? v : v.attr("order", order);
455   }
456
457   private Order requireOrder(long id, long orderId) {
458      var o = store().getOrder(orderId);
459      if (o == null || o.getPetId() != id)
460         throw new NotFound("Unknown order '%s'", orderId);
461      return o;
462   }
463
464   /**
465    * @param id The pet id.
466    * @return The live pet.
467    * @throws NotFound If it does not exist.
468    */
469   protected Pet require(long id) {
470      var p = store().getPet(id);
471      if (p == null)
472         throw new NotFound("Unknown pet '%s'", id);
473      return p;
474   }
475
476   /** Unwraps the dialog envelope ({@code fields}) if present; otherwise the body is the pet itself. */
477   private static Pet toPet(JsonMap body) {
478      var fields = body.getMap("fields");
479      var src = fields != null ? fields : body;
480      try {
481         return Json.to(Json.of(src), Pet.class);
482      } catch (ParseException e) {
483         throw new BadRequest("Invalid pet: '%s'", e.getMessage());
484      }
485   }
486
487   private static void validate(Pet p) {
488      if (p.getName() == null || p.getName().isBlank())
489         throw new BadRequest("Name must not be blank");
490      if (Float.isNaN(p.getPrice()) || Float.isInfinite(p.getPrice()) || p.getPrice() < 0)
491         throw new BadRequest("Price '%s' must be a non-negative number", p.getPrice());
492   }
